label: T1
name: Moment-corrected smooth density
statement: C_c^infty([a,A]) with Mellin vanishings at 0 and 1 is dense in the corresponding L2 moment-corrected generator space.

label: T2
name: Burnol co-Poisson carrier theorem
statement: For a<1 the perpendicular complement of the zero-evaluator span Y_a in L_a is the co-Poisson subspace P_a; at a=1 the evaluator system is complete/minimal.

label: T3
name: Atom-exhaustion gate
statement: Declared co-Poisson atom spaces P_{a,N} must exhaust P_a.

label: T4
name: Residual decomposition theorem
statement: If P_N -> P_a strongly, the finite boundary visibility residual converges to the boundary-to-P_a residual.

label: T5
name: Boundary inclusion criterion
statement: Under atom exhaustion, c_N -> 1 iff the boundary dictionary is contained in P_a.

label: T6
name: Boundary-to-co-Poisson inclusion theorem
statement: P_infty tau_l (I-P_infty)Y^- must lie in P_a or have a controlled defect.
